safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting that headaches occur without any pre-aura/presymptoms reduces the ability to distinguish migraine with aura from other headache syndromes and may weaken diagnostic clarity. This typically leads to follow-up questioning rather than immediate harm.
